comments.text: how communities adapted to the landscape

replies.author: @EXPLOREHORIZONS66
replies.text: Communities adapted by using techniques like carving homes directly into volcanic rock or building into cliffs to gain natural insulation and protection.

comments.author: @unknownplanetdoc
comments.text: People focus on how dangerous these homes look, but I’m more impressed by how communities adapted to the landscape.

replies.author: @EXPLOREHORIZONS66
replies.text: Absolutely! It’s amazing how people have turned such challenging landscapes into places they can call home.
